review_notes: I read the whole file and the definitions of stopDepth (Dominate.lean) and ancReach (Leaves.lean). I grepped for uses of stopDepth_zero and ancReach_root: the only uses are in canonSt_dom in this file. The file has no simp attributes and no loops or competing rules. The only simp-interface weakness I found is the pair of root-normalisation lemmas, which are used by manual rw/show. This is a minor finding. I could not run Lean, so I don't claim the simp set would close the goal as written.

findings.excerpt: theorem stopDepth_zero (ab : Option Nat) : stopDepth 0 ab = 0 := by
findings.problem: stopDepth is a plain def by cases on the Option, and Optimal.lean unfolds it with `simp only [stopDepth, ...]` at many sites. The root-depth normalisation `stopDepth 0 ab = 0` is a canonical, terminating rewrite (the RHS is a literal and the LHS head does not reappear), but it is not tagged @[simp]. `ancReach_root` is likewise an `Iff.rfl` bridge from `ancReach n f #[] 0 k` to `Leafkey n f k` without @[simp]. The only use, in `canonSt_dom`, has to hand-assemble the rewrite with `rw [show (#[] : Array Nat).size = 0 from rfl, stopDepth_zero] at hd` and an explicit `(ancReach_root n f k).2 hk`. So a root-instantiated `dfsNode_dom` cannot be cleaned up by `simp at hd`. Any other root-level instantiation would need the same manual steps.
findings.proposed_change: Mark `stopDepth_zero` with `@[simp]`. Optionally mark `ancReach_root` `@[simp]` too, so that `simp` normalises `ancReach n f #[] 0 k` to `Leafkey n f k`. Then the `rw [show (#[] : Array Nat).size = 0 from rfl, stopDepth_zero] at hd` step could become `simp at hd`, since `Array.size_empty` is already a simp lemma. Keep the `Iff.rfl` proof. Both rules are orientation-safe: neither right-hand side contains the left-hand head, so there is no cycle risk.
findings.benefit: The root case of the correctness argument becomes a plain `simp` normalisation. The brittle `show ... from rfl` rewrite goes away. Future root-instantiated uses of the dominance lemmas get the canonical forms `0` and `Leafkey` automatically.

evidence.excerpt: def stopDepth (d : Nat) : Option Nat → Nat
rw [show (#[] : Array Nat).size = 0 from rfl, stopDepth_zero] at hd
